summary: OIO Group filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of its business combination with De Tomaso Automobili Holdings Limited, making De Tomaso a wholly owned subsidiary. In connection, OIO effected a 1-for-3 reverse stock split and issued 333,333,334 ordinary shares as consideration, resulting in De Tomaso shareholders holding ~95.8% of post-combination shares, with founder Norman Choi beneficially owning ~67.6%. The existing board and management remain in place pending a governance transition after the 20-F filing. This reverse merger provides a Nasdaq listing for De Tomaso. Watch for integration execution, Nasdaq compliance, and regulatory filings following the change of control.
